Run low-level host operations

Validate, plan, apply, verify, and inspect signed host deployment data. These commands
are intended for release tooling and administrators.

Usage:
  unyolo system <command>

Commands:
  apply     Apply an exact reviewed deployment plan
  doctor    Diagnose low-level host runtime problems
  export    Export observed deployment state
  install   Install a signed host runtime
  plan      Create a reviewed deployment plan
  profile   Manage locked deployment profiles
  rollback  Roll back the active host runtime
  status    Show low-level host runtime status
  upgrade   Upgrade the signed host runtime
  validate  Validate a deployment profile
  verify    Verify the active deployment

Options:
  -h, --help  show help

Run "unyolo help system <command>" for more information.
